entries.title: Judges 21:1
segments: Engagements made in the heat of passion often end in bitter repentance.

entries.title: Judges 21:5
segments: Civil wars, and those waged among brethren, are often most cruel, and lead on from one degree of enormity to another, till multitudes of both parties are overwhelmed in common woe.

entries.title: Judges 21:8
segments: Jabesh-gilead; a city in the half-tribe of Manasseh, on the east of Jordan.

entries.title: Judges 21:10
segments: Men may be very scrupulous about moral obligation in some things, and most regardless of it in others.

entries.title: Judges 21:12
segments: In the land of Canaan; on the west side of Jordan.

entries.title: Judges 21:14
segments: Conscience unenlightened and blinded by sin, is a very unsafe guide. What it forbids men to do directly, it often suffers them to do indirectly, and under circumstances which greatly increase their guilt.

entries.title: Judges 21:18
segments: Men may be so blinded by sin as to think that the giving of one wife, with her own consent and that of her parents, to one man is a crime; and that being accessory by robbery and violence to the giving, without their consent or that of their parents, of two hundred wives to two hundred men, is a worthy deed.  Surely, he that trusteth in his own heart is a fool.

entries.title: Judges 21:22
segments: Ye did not give unto them; by this they imply that they do not violate the oath spoken of in
, as the women were not taken by their consent.

entries.title: Judges 21:23
segments: Persons may sometimes be married very improperly, and without the consent of friends; yet after their marriage has occurred, and cannot be revoked, it is usually wise for friends cheerfully to acquiesce, and strive to make the connection as useful as possible.
